messages:
Avery (CSM): Hi all — kicking off Savannah onboarding. Proposed kickoff: Tue 11am PT. Core goals: data in sandbox, security sign-off, 30/60/90 milestones and basic evals. Who takes which owner role?

Priya (Eng): I can take sandbox setup and integration. Target: sandbox + test creds by Mon EOD.

Liam (Solutions): I'll run data mapping and ingestion templates. @Sam can you share a small sample dataset (anonymized) so I can map fields?

Sam (Savannah): Sharing an anonymized sample in Drive now — link in DM. Will also add a glossary of field meanings.

Miguel (CS): Security note: customer requires KMS + IP allowlist. I'll produce our KMS integration checklist and a short network rules doc by Wed. Potential delay if customer needs our on-prem package.

Emilia (Product): Success criteria proposal: 1) basic inference chain validated in sandbox (end-to-end) by day 14; 2) p95 latency < 800ms on dev profile; 3) Two primary flows handling expected edge cases with >= 85% accuracy on eval prompts by day 60. Need customer-supplied eval prompts.

Avery (CSM): Risks: firewall changes, missing sample data, and potential model tuning. Let's prioritize the eval prompts and sample dataset this week.

enablement-bot: Playbook created -> /playbooks/savannah-onboarding-v2. Tasks auto-assigned: Avery (owner), Priya (integration), Liam (data mapping), Miguel (security).

Priya (Eng): Quick sync idea: dry-run the kickoff agenda Fri 9am PT to confirm handoffs. I'll have endpoints ready then.

Sam (Savannah): Fri 9am PT ok. I'll have the glossary and sample JSON ready.

Liam (Solutions): I'll draft the data mapping questionnaire and post it here by Thu so customer has time to respond before kickoff.

Miguel (CS): FYI, KMS approval typically takes ~5 business days after checklist completion. If customer insists on KMS day-0, mark that as a hard dependency.

Avery (CSM): Action list: Priya -> sandbox + creds; Liam -> data questionnaire; Miguel -> KMS checklist; Emilia -> share internal eval prompt templates; Sam -> upload sample dataset and glossary; Avery -> calendar invites + one-pager. I'll follow up on Fri dry-run invite. :calendar:
